name: dealer-search-strategy
description: Generate a comprehensive search strategy document for a car dealership covering SEO (Search Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). Clarifies the difference between SEO, AEO, and GEO. Produces a unified 4-pillar strategy with an integrated 90-day roadmap. Covers traditional Google ranking, AI engine citation (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot), local SEO, technical foundation, and cross-channel reputation. Names the specific marketplace skills as execution tools.
